title: Programming a night's dance
summary: With no printed program the band followed the same format nightly, changing for requests.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: Well, there was no program. You're playing every night so you're almost following the same format. Unless there was a request within the area of time that you were playing and you would try to play the request, which would deviate just a little bit from the normal procedure every night.
You never had any printed program, anything you wrote up yourself and the numbers on?
No. No. That wasn't anything like that in those days.
